chunks: And We rained down on them a shower (of stones). So witness the end of the sinners!
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'And We rained down on them a shower' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the specific nature of divine retribution against the people of Lot, where the 'rain' of stones serves as a physical manifestation of their moral corruption. It underscores the concept of 'Aqibah' (the end result) as a direct consequence of transgressing divine limits, inviting believers to reflect on the tangible outcomes of their own actions.
